run_fit_references_cli: run the fit_references script with --config and --out-path arguments to fit linear element references
fit_linref_function: fit linear element references from a training dataset using a config dict and save checkpoints
load_config_yaml: load a YAML configuration file and detect duplicate keys or include entries
save_checkpoint_state_dict: save a PyTorch model state dict to a checkpoint file at the specified output path
fit_linear_references_module: fit linear references for specified targets using a dataset with configurable batch size and workers
